name: Al-Shamela Bookstore
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'test -f .env && echo .env-ok || echo MISSING-.env; grep -q "^DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=.\+" .env && echo secret-ok || echo EMPTY-DJANGO_SECRET_KEY; grep -q "^DJANGO_DEBUG=.\+" .env && echo debug-ok || echo EMPTY-DJANGO_DEBUG; grep -q "^POSTGRES_USER=.\+" .env && echo pguser-ok || echo EMPTY-POSTGRES_USER; grep -q "^POSTGRES_DB=.\+" .env && echo pgdb-ok || echo EMPTY-POSTGRES_DB; grep -q "^POSTGRES_PASSWORD=.\+" .env && echo pgpass-ok || echo EMPTY-POSTGRES_PASSWORD; grep -q "^DATABASE_URL=.*@postgres:5432.*" .env && echo dburl-ok || echo BAD-DATABASE_URL-needs-@postgres:5432; grep -q "^TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=.\+" .env && echo tg-token-ok || echo EMPTY-TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN; grep -q "^TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID=.\+" .env && echo tg-chat-ok || echo EMPTY-TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID; pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -d web ]; then (cd web && npm install --legacy-peer-deps 2>/dev/null || true); fi; echo postCreate-done'
